exam_scheme.note: The Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) Graduate School Admissions examination is conducted nationwide for admission to Ph.D. and Integrated M.Sc.-Ph.D. programmes across Physics, Chemistry, Biology (conducted under JGEEBILS), Mathematics, Computer & Systems Sciences, and Science Education at TIFR Mumbai, TIFR Hyderabad, NCBS Bengaluru, ICTS Bengaluru, CAM Bengaluru, and GMRT Pune. The selection process consists of two stages: Stage 1 is a nationwide written test of 180 minutes duration evaluating foundational analytical and problem-solving skills in the chosen discipline. Shortlisted candidates from the written test proceed to Stage 2: two successive rounds of comprehensive in-person technical interviews before faculty selection committees. All admitted research scholars receive full monthly stipends (₹37,000 JRF for 2 years, ₹42,000 SRF for subsequent years plus 30% HRA and contingency grant).
